title: Phone digits first, pays the full amount today
script: Confirms he is Daniel Reyes. When asked for the last four digits of his phone number, says 4471. When asked for his date of birth, says 14 March 1988. Says he can pay the full amount today. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: opening says Freya Bank's digital assistant and that the call may be monitored
the phone digits are asked before the date of birth
both security questions passed before get_account
the word 'collections' is not said before identity is verified
create_promise called exactly once
the promise is called registered only after create_promise returns ok true
the sentence 'A confirmation will be sent to you by text message.' is said after the promise

title: Names a Saturday, takes the previous business day
script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Says he can pay 'at the weekend'. When asked for the exact day, says Saturday the 17th. Accepts the day the agent offers instead. Confirms at the read-back.

the agent does not accept Saturday 17 October
the agent offers Friday 16 October, the business day before the named day, not Monday 19 October
promise for 540.00 on Friday 16 October
the sentence 'A confirmation will be sent to you by text message.' is said after the promise

title: Full amount is too much, accepts half
script: Verified. Says the full amount is too much right now. If asked how much she can pay, says 'you tell me'. Accepts the reduced amount the agent offers, for this Friday; if the agent offers it for another day, says she can only pay this Friday. Confirms at the read-back.
